{"code": "
import openpyxl
src = openpyxl.load_workbook("./materials/FinancialStatementFY26Q4.xlsx", data_only=False)
dst = openpyxl.Workbook()
# Remove default sheet
dst.remove(dst.active)
# Copy each sheet by name
for name in src.sheetnames:
    ws_src = src[name]
    ws_dst = dst.create_sheet(title=name)
    # Copy values, styles, merged cells, dimensions
    for row in ws_src.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            if cell.value is not None:
                dst_cell = ws_dst.cell(row=cell.row, column=cell.column, value=cell.value)
                # copy style
                if cell.has_style:
                    dst_cell.font = cell.font.copy()
                    dst_cell.border = cell.border.copy()
                    dst_cell.fill = cell.fill.copy()
                    dst_cell.number_format = cell.number_format
                    dst_cell.protection = cell.protection.copy()
                    dst_cell.alignment = cell.alignment.copy()
    # Copy merged cells
    for mr in ws_src.merged_cells.ranges:
        ws_dst.merge_cells(str(mr))
    # Copy column widths
    for col_letter, dim in ws_src.column_dimensions.items():
        ws_dst.column_dimensions[col_letter].width = dim.width
    # Copy row heights
    for row_num, dim in ws_src.row_dimensions.items():
        ws_dst.row_dimensions[row_num].height = dim.height
    # Copy freeze panes
    ws_dst.freeze_panes = ws_src.freeze_panes

dst.save("summary.xlsx")
print("Saved summary.xlsx")
print("Sheets:", dst.sheetnames)
"}

import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("summary.xlsx")
ws = wb.create_sheet("Summary")
# Title
ws['A1'] = 'MICROSOFT CORPORATION'
ws['A2'] = 'SEGMENT SUMMARY — Three Months Ended June 30, 2026'
ws['A3'] = '(In millions) (Unaudited)'

# Headers row 5
ws['A5'] = 'Segment'
ws['B5'] = 'Revenue'
ws['C5'] = 'Operating income'
ws['D5'] = 'Operating margin'

# Three segments, referencing Segment Results 'Segment Results' sheet
# Productivity and Business Processes -> row 10 revenue B10, row 13 operating income B13
# Intelligent Cloud -> row 15 revenue B15, row 18 operating income B18
# More Personal Computing -> row 20 revenue B20, row 23 operating income B23
# Total -> row 25 revenue B25, row 28 operating income B28

ws['A6'] = 'Productivity and Business Processes'
ws['B6'] = "='Segment Results'!B10"
ws['C6'] = "='Segment Results'!B13"
ws['D6'] = '=C6/B6'

ws['A7'] = 'Intelligent Cloud'
ws['B7'] = "='Segment Results'!B15"
ws['C7'] = "='Segment Results'!B18"
ws['D7'] = '=C7/B7'

ws['A8'] = 'More Personal Computing'
ws['B8'] = "='Segment Results'!B20"
ws['C8'] = "='Segment Results'!B23"
ws['D8'] = '=C8/B8'

ws['A9'] = 'Total'
ws['B9'] = '=B6+B7+B8'
ws['C9'] = '=C6+C7+C8'
ws['D9'] = '=C9/B9'

# Format percentages
for r in range(6, 10):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).number_format = '0.0%'
for r in range(6, 10):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).number_format = '#,##0'
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).number_format = '#,##0'

# Column widths
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 40
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 16
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 16

wb.save("summary.xlsx")
print("Saved with Summary sheet")
"}
